caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate vessel, likely a ceramic or pottery bowl, placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The bowl is predominantly brown with a glossy finish and exhibits shades of dark green and reddish-brown, especially around the rim and base. The upper edge of the bowl is scalloped and uneven, adding texture, and the bowl sits on a short pedestal base that has a ridged design. On the surface of the bowl, there is cursive writing in a dark brown or black color; the text includes the words "Remember" and "August 11, 1850" along with other less legible script. The interior of the bowl is shadowed, suggesting depth. The drawing includes a signature in the lower right corner, reading "E.H. Shellenberger" followed by a number, possibly a date or catalog number.
title: Pa. German Plate
